cover.alt: Illustrated VBS Songs cover with children singing around an open Bible

intro.summary: A collection of English hymns and traditional songs selected for Vacation Bible School, Sunday school, and group singing.
intro.description: Sing familiar songs about faith, creation, joy, courage, and the life of Jesus. The digital records preserve available source text and identify rights information separately for each song and language.

credits.compiledBy: Selected English hymn and traditional-song sources
credits.publisher: Original publishers vary; see individual source records.
credits.rights: The Schema 2.1 song records currently mark rights as unknown. Verify each text, translation, arrangement and intended use before public redistribution; modern recordings and arrangements may have separate rights.

changelog.note: Expanded to 36 songs with child-friendly mission songs and adult congregational hymns for mixed-age VBS worship.
First edition with eighteen public-domain English songs for children and group worship.
